title: ECE Paris
subtitle: Engineering Degree in Computer Science — Cybersecurity Major
description: Five-year engineering program, specializing in cybersecurity through the International Track.
highlights: A broad engineering foundation in the first years (math, electronics, physics, programming), followed by a deep dive into cybersecurity: Cryptography, Network & Cloud Security, DevOps with SRE, Windows/Linux Security, SOC Analysis, Machine Learning, and even LLMs for Cybersecurity.
project: End-of-studies project (PPE): research on cyber-attacks targeting solar inverters.
story: A brand new chapter of my life — I met incredible people, made the friends I still have today, learned what it means to be a nerd pulling all-nighters on projects, and still found time to socialize at parties.
